steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Good going, Kawa-kawa! You've got guts!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I hereby declare, you are now the fourth member of Team Hella of the MBCC Special Combat Force!
Kawa-kawa wipes his nose and smiles bashfully.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: My ambition is to follow my predecessors, finish charting WhiteSands and find the safest route! It's just the basics of navigation! Think nothing of it!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: My whole purpose here is to protect you guys and lead the way, so I'm happy whenever I can be of help!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: We can't relax just yet! The desert bandit attack hasn't stopped yet.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: You can count on me to have your backs! Go and fight them without worry!
